description: This file contains utility functions related to auditing and traceability for a tic-tac-toe web application. Specifically, it includes functions to create audit event objects, append events to an audit log, and generate default user contexts, supporting compliance, data integrity, and traceability.

methods.name: auditEventFactory(userContext, actor, action, before, after, metadata = {}, reason = '')
methods.description: Creates and returns an audit event object with metadata such as timestamp, user ID, actor, action type, snapshots before and after, optional metadata, and reason for the event.

methods.name: appendAudit(auditLog, event)
methods.description: Appends an audit event to an existing audit log array, returning a new array to ensure immutability.

methods.name: getDefaultUserContext()
methods.description: Provides a default user context object with a generic user ID and role placeholder, useful for initializing audit processes.

ctags.name: auditEventFactory
ctags.pattern: /^export function auditEventFactory(userContext, actor, action, before, after, metadata = {}, reas/
ctags.signature: (userContext, actor, action, before, after, metadata = {}, reason = '')
